name: Azmara
source:
Azmara is the older sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c153646]Azazel[/url]. She's confident, elegant, and very powerful. She has many demonic powers that she can activate with the snap of a finger. Ever since walking in on the [url=https://vndb.org/c153641]Professor[/url] and Azazel, she has pursued him out of lust and jealousy.

[In game description]
